messages:
alex: Quick sync: customers keep asking for a migration calendar + a self-serve way to delay cutover per-tenant. Proposing: a calendar page in Console + a temporary pin-exception API. Kickoff thoughts?

maria: Console calendar makes sense. UX question: should scheduling be free or consume reserved "grace credits"? Also need guardrails to avoid infinite delays.

ben: From infra: pin-exception API is doable. Suggest a 30-day max automated pin that records audit log and requires an explicit reason. We can cap concurrent exceptions per tenant group to avoid capacity issues.

linus: Ops note: scheduling personal cutovers will increase deploy surface area. We need an automated slot allocation system so nightly deploy windows don't get saturated.

sara: CS perspective: enterprise customers want an SLA-affecting option where they can request a guaranteed maintenance window and a named engineer for cutover. That's separate from self-serve pinning. Also 14-day notice for non-urgent changes is table stakes.

legal-bot: Flag: long-duration pinning may trigger contract amendments for certain enterprise customers. If >14 days, require sign-off by Legal.

alex: Proposed API surface (v1):
```
POST /v1/customers/{id}/pin-exception
body: {
  "target_model": "model-v2",
  "duration_days": 30,
  "reason": "compatibility test",
  "requested_by": "user@company.com"
}
response: 200 -> {"exception_id": "ex_123", "expires_at": "2026-05-03T12:00:00Z"}
```
We should include fields: approval_required (bool), audit_log_link, and opt-out_url for customers.

maria: Add telemetry hooks: when exception issued -> emit metric pin_exception.count with tags (tenant, duration, approved). Also show active exceptions on model dashboard.

ben: Implementation notes: backend will map exception to routing policy: route to older model for tenant X until expiry. We'll add a feature-flag gated rollout. Need DB migration to store exceptions + TTLs.

linus: For scheduling calendar: algorithm sketch: tenants pick preferred window (date+2hr slot). System assigns earliest available slot respecting zone/engineer coverage. If conflict, offer next slot. We'll need capacity forecasts by region.

sara: Customer comms: propose two templates: 1) migration notice (default 14 days), 2) confirmation for scheduled personal cutover (includes contact + fallback plan). I'll draft both.

alex: Risk and policy bullets:
- pin-exception abuse: limit to 2 concurrent exceptions per tenant, require reason, auto-expire
- contracted SLAs: if customer elects long pin, note possible performance regressions and bill adjustment
- auditability: every pin must create an immutable audit entry + notification to security/compliance

legal-bot: Also add a checkbox in Console: "I understand this may extend my exposure to known issues" for >7 day pins. That should help with signatures.

maria: Monitoring + alerts: when active exceptions > 10% of total tenants in a cluster -> alert SRE/PM. Also track exception churn (create/delete within 7d).

ben: Draft task list (engineering):
- DB schema for pin_exceptions (ben) -> due 3061130200
- routing policy + feature flag (ben, linus) -> due 3061130300
- API + Console hook (maria + frontend) -> due 3061130350
- audit/logging + metrics (linus) -> due 3061130325

alex: Product decisions:
- default pin max: 30 days (configurable per enterprise contract)
- self-serve allowed for non-contracted tenants up to 7 days, >7 days requires CS approval
- enterprise named-engineer cutovers handled via Support SOW (out-of-band)

sara: I'll create a customer FAQ: how to request a personal cutover, costs, and rollback procedures. Include a sample email for Account Execs.

ops-bot: Deploy window suggestion: reserve 2026-04-08 00:00-08:00 UTC for initial pilot. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

alex: Next steps: maria + ben pair on API schema by EOD, sara drafts comms template by EOD, linus to produce capacity forecast draft by EOD. We'll reconvene tomorrow.

maria: ack

ben: ack

sara: ack

linus: ack
